Whether you are looking for the best deals on chlorine tablets and other maintenance essentials, or you need to find fun pool floats, we have you covered. While you’re in, talk to any of our pool experts and get the best solutions for your pool or spa maintenance issues. At Leslie's Desoto, Texas, find any pool equipment you want or need — including pool pumps, pool motors, heating & cooling, automatic cleaners, cleaning attachments, and much more. Come in today and let Leslie’s help you make perfect poolside memories. Expert Advice In-Store and Online Resources Price Match Promise If You Find A Lower Price, We Will Match It Free Water Testing Customized Treatment Plans Free In-Store Repair Labor You Only Pay For Parts Free APC Inspection Thousands of Parts In Stock Mobile App Track Water Tests, Rewards, and More At Leslie's, we know pools. But we're more than just pool experts — we're dedicated to helping you get the most out of your pool experience. Whether you're in need of the highest quality pool products always in stock, complimentary in-store AccuBlue® water testing, free in-store labor for pool cleaner repairs, or a range of convenient at-home services from our nationwide service department, Leslie's has you covered. Your local Leslie's is not just a destination for pool maintenance essentials — it's a hub of enjoyment. Explore our collection of fun accessories, including pool toys, vibrant floats, thrilling outdoor games, patio accessories, and more, designed to enhance your poolside lifestyle. And don't forget to ask us about our Price Match Promise — if you find a lower competitor's price, we will match it. No matter what you may need to keep your pool or spa clean, safe, and beautiful, you can always count on Leslie's to help you get the job done right the first time. Frequently Asked Questions What is Leslie's return policy? If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you can return your item(s) within 30 days for a replacement or refund. Products must be unused, in new condition, and in original packaging. You can find more information sabout our policy and exclusions on our Returns & Exchanges page . Do you have a price match policy? Leslie's is proud to offer competitive prices on the highest quality products you need for your pool. If you find a current lower price on an identical, in-stock item from a qualified local or online retailer, we will match the price. Some exclusions apply. You can learn more about this on our policy page for Leslie's Price Match Promise . Does Leslie's offer in-store pickup for online orders With Leslie's, you have the ability to buy the products you need online, in the store, or buy online and pick up in store — whatever is most convenient for you! If you'd like to pick your order up at your local Leslie's, all you need to do is select your preferred store when adding an item to your digital shopping cart. You'll be able to see available inventory at the store(s) closest to your address, so you can select the pickup option that's best for you. After checkout, you'll receive emails with updates about your order status, including a notification when your order is ready for pickup. Why should I sign up for Leslie's Pool Perks? Pool Perks is a loyalty rewards program that offers many great benefits for pool owners. It's FREE to sign up, and you'll automatically start earning points back in Perks rewards on every purchase. You'll also receive exclusive members-only offers and promotions, free shipping for online orders, and lots of other great benefits . What's the difference between AccuBlue® and AccuBlue Home®? If you're familiar with Leslie's in-store water testing experience, you're probably familiar with the power of Leslie's AccuBlue® technology. It's the best way to get comprehensive, precise water test results, and it comes with a customized water treatment plan. With an AccuBlue Home® membership, you can get the same level of water testing accuracy and reliability in the comfort of your own home, with a customized water treatment plan delivered right to your phone. Members receive a state-of-the-art testing device, and the $50 monthly membership fee essentially pays for itself in store credits to purchase the supplies you need. It's the total solution for a clean, safe, and beautiful pool. You can learn more about the program by visiting our page about AccuBlue Home . What kinds of pool equipment can Leslie's repair? Leslie's offers FREE in-store labor on equipment repairs — you only pay for parts. This is perfect for automatic pool cleaners, which are the most frequently repaired pieces of pool equipment. If your robotic, suction side, or pressure side cleaner isn't working as expected, shows wear and tear, or is simply due for a tune-up, just bring it to your local Leslie's for a FREE inspection. If it needs new parts, that's the only thing you'll pay for. We provide the repair labor as a complimentary in-store service. If you're having problems with your pool pump, you can also bring the motor in for a FREE diagnostic test. While we don't repair motors directly, we can help you in finding a replacement capacitor or a new motor, if need be. If you're having trouble with larger and heavier equipment, like your filter, heater, or the pool pump itself, this is where our at-home services come in handy. Stop by your local Leslie's to schedule an appointment with one of our certified service technicians, or you can request an appointment online . You can also learn more about our in-store repair services in this Resource Center article . reviews.text: Manager, Gary, has done a superlative job in listening to our concerns and resolving our issues with the pool and Polaris cleaner. We highly recommend Gary to those who need help with their pool concerns.
reviews.author: M S

reviews.text: Install tech failed to show on his initial promised date/time and then needed to reschedule. Also, received a used/dirty and defective pool pump which had apparently been returned by another customer to the Desoto, TX store. Not real sure why the store manager, Gary, would have given me a defective product after I paid full price for a brand new one. The installation tech had to return the used/dirty pump back to the Desoto, TX location and pick up a new one at their Midlothian, TX store. Overall, the experience made me question why I chose Leslie's Pool Supply in the first place and I will probably not ever do business with them again.
reviews.author: Fred J

reviews.text: Employees are friendly and helpful, and the store is clean, but the credit card machine has been down for over a week so my card had to be entered manually which took forever and backed up the checkout line. Come on, seriously?!? A week?!? Get someone out there to fix the stupid machine.
reviews.author: Christine Spera

reviews.text:
Josh is the manager with Jonathan as Asst. Manager. These two guys are the nicest people. Josh is very knowledgeable in pool products and service. We've been coming here for almost 3 years and will continue.
On a recent visit we encountered a customer who was very rude to Jonathon. He continued bashing him at the checkout. Very inappropriate. Jonathon handled the situation very professionally and with kindness. The man was still being hateful when we left.
We live in an unkind world now.  A little kindness goes a long way. These two guys deserve more respect than given. If your having a bad day, go home. Leslie's Pools has two great employees here in DeSoto, TX.
reviews.author: Catherine Orcutt

reviews.text: Gary is superb and works hard for his store. Bravo
reviews.author: edward rivera

reviews.text: Leslie's is the best place in Desoto Texas to shop for pool supplies.  My wife went there on July 3rd after she left another pool supplier that had a toxic atmosphere. Glad she did.  The customer service was excellent.  The young man at the counter was helpful and courteous.  There were two clerks there and they were both friendly, great attitude and helpful.  We have a new supply store offBeltline and Polk

reviews.text: I love this store! So helpful and courteous. They go out of their way to help with a smile. Such a joy to shop there; they have great products and the staff is very knowledgeable.

data.summary: The local store reviews on Google and Yelp appear authentic and largely positive, highlighting specific staff and experiences. The severe negative rating on Trustpilot is a significant discrepancy but likely reflects a separate channel (e.g., e-commerce, corporate service) rather than the local retail experience being reviewed. The BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint resolution. There is no evidence of review manipulation for the local store.
fake_signals: Limited review volume on primary platforms (Google, Yelp) for a national chain
authentic_signals: Specific details in reviews (manager names, product issues, store locations)
Mix of praise and specific complaints
Emotionally authentic language in both positive and negative reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: Trustpilot rating (1.6) is a severe outlier compared to Google (4.3), Yelp (4.2), and BBB (A+). This suggests Trustpilot may be capturing a different customer segment (e.g., online shoppers, corporate complaints) or is being targeted by dissatisfied customers, while local store reviews are positive.
